summary: Iteration-5 full test of the three new features (rent receipt PDFs, combined overview, vacancy tracking) plus the requested light regression. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter5_receipts_overview_vacancy.py — 30/30 passing (receipt PDF per kind with title/receipt-no/property/tenant/month/date/mode/amount, rent-receipt monthly-rent/paid/balance + 'Nil' when fully paid, 404 unknown id, 400 bad id, 403 resident; /api/overview cross-checked figure-by-figure against /api/statement per building and /api/rentals/rent-roll, month validation 400/422, resident 403, unauthenticated 401; vacancy vacant_since/vacant_days/lost_rent + totals, vacant billing 0, lease_end fallback, no-date 0, garbage date no-500, future date clamped, CSV+PDF vacancy summary lines). Frontend (1920x1080 + 390x844): Combined Overview reachable via nav-overview in BOTH workspaces and mobile drawer, own month picker, 4 stat cards, both tables with totals rows, on-behalf tally card, row click-through to /mis and /rentals; receipt-btn downloads a valid 2.3KB PDF with success toast and receipt-share opens wa.me with property/month/amount/date/mode; vacancy-alert, rent-stat-vacancy and inline vacant-days-{name} all correct; Units status=vacant reveals unit-vacant-since-input which persists and drives the rent roll; Reports vacancy card + CSV/PDF buttons render; no page-shell horizontal overflow on mobile; resident is blocked from /overview (redirected to /my-dues, nav hidden).

minor.issue: Buildings without a period document for the requested month are silently skipped, so a building that has maintenance activity but no period row never appears in the maintenance table (UI then shows 'No building period for this month.'). Acceptable by design but worth confirming.

Vacancy metrics are not month-scoped: vacant_days/lost_rent are always computed as (today - vacant_since) using the unit's CURRENT status, so requesting a past month returns the same cumulative loss (e.g. July 2026 rent roll and Overview both reported the same Rs.98,554.53 as August). Consider clamping the vacancy window to the requested month.

A unit whose lease_start is in the future is reported status='vacant' for earlier months even though it was never vacant; it then inflates totals.vacant / the vacancy-alert count while contributing 0 vacant_days, so the alert count can disagree with the rows listed in the Reports vacancy card (e.g. '2 vacant properties' but only 1 row with a since-date).
Row payload has no rent_amount, which is why the Reports vacancy card cannot show the monthly rent of a vacant unit (see frontend bug).

ui_bugs.issue: 'Monthly rent' column always renders Rs.0.00 for vacant units because it uses money(r.rent_due || 0) and rent_due is 0 by definition for a vacant unit (verified: QA unit with rent 30,000 showed Rs.0.00 while Rent forgone Rs.98,554.53 rendered correctly). Expose rent_amount on the rent-roll row and use it here (the totals cell for that column is also left blank).
Sub-line 'Rs.x lost to vacancy' is shown for historical months too because lost_rent is not month-scoped (July 2026 showed the same figure as August). Cosmetic consequence of the backend issue above.
The properties table shows only the 'Vacant' status pill; the newly captured 'vacant since' date is not surfaced anywhere on that page (has to be re-opened in edit to see it). Nice-to-have column.

issues: Page keeps the maintenance header property/period switchers alongside its own month picker, which can read as two conflicting month controls (overview-month-input is the one that drives the data) — consider hiding or visually de-emphasising the header period switcher on this route.
Date inputs use the native browser date picker (input type=date) rather than the shadcn calendar; pre-existing app-wide pattern, flagged only for consistency.

action_items: Fix Reports vacancy card 'Monthly rent' column (add rent_amount to the rent-roll row and render it; also fill the totals cell).
Decide whether vacancy days/lost rent should be scoped to the selected month instead of always being 'today minus vacant_since' (currently past months show today's cumulative loss).
Consider not counting future-lease (never-occupied) units as 'vacant' so the vacancy-alert count matches the vacancy table rows.

Test-hygiene (owner: dev/next tester): tests/test_iter4_rentals_annual.py calls POST /api/rentals/demo/seed, which re-creates the 3 demo rental units inside the user's live preview data — gate it or clean up after; tests/test_media_notify.py::TestStatementNotify asserts hard-coded building totals (6500/8600) and fails whenever a sibling test concurrently adds a charge or leaves one behind.
critical_code_review_comments: rentals.build_rent_roll(): the vacancy block keys off u['status'] (a point-in-time field) inside a month-parameterised report — historical rent rolls therefore report present-day vacancy loss. Snapshot or clamp to month_bounds(month).
rentals.build_rent_roll(): loads ALL collections (to_list(5000)) on every call just to compute deposit_held; an aggregation pipeline or a per-unit query would scale better.
server.combined_overview(): calls build_statement per property in a serial loop; fine at 2 buildings but consider asyncio.gather when building counts grow.
rentals.py is at 542 lines with the CSV/PDF exporters and the receipt builder inline — split reporting/pdf helpers into their own module before it crosses the 700-line limit.

success_rate.backend: 100% (30/30 new iteration-5 tests; 113/114 legacy tests, the single failure is a racy hard-coded-total legacy assertion that passes in isolation)
success_rate.frontend: 97% (all iteration-5 flows pass; 1 real UI bug — Reports vacancy 'Monthly rent' column)

context_for_next_testing_agent: New regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_iter5_receipts_overview_vacancy.py (contains a dependency-free PDF text extractor pdf_text() that ASCII85+Flate-decodes reportlab streams — reuse it, no pypdf is installed). Run pytest per-file rather than the whole tests/ dir: the suites share one live preview DB and the -n 2 loadscope run produced cross-test interference (iter4 lease-expiry/on-behalf-tally, media/notify uploads) that all pass when run in isolation. Do NOT run the whole dir without cleaning up afterwards: tests/test_iter4_rentals_annual.py re-seeds 3 demo rental units into the user's live data and test_media_notify leaves TEST_ charges behind on Sunrise Residency (both restored by me this iteration). Playbook auth checks re-verified: bcrypt $2b$ hash format, httpOnly cookie on login, brute-force lockout, seed_admin update — all pass; the only CORS failure is the edge proxy rewriting Access-Control-Allow-Origin to '*' (localhost:8001 correctly returns the explicit origin + allow-credentials: true), a known non-issue.
rca_of_the_issue: Reports vacancy 'Monthly rent' = Rs.0.00: RentReport.jsx line ~95 renders money(r.rent_due || 0), but build_rent_roll() sets rent_due = 0 whenever lease_active() is false, which is always true for a vacant unit; the row never carries the unit's rent_amount, so the column has no source of truth. Fix at the API (add rent_amount to each rent-roll row) and switch the cell to it. Repro: create a unit with status=vacant, rent 30000, vacant_since 100 days ago -> /rentals/report vacancy card shows idle days 100 and forgone Rs.98,554.53 but monthly rent Rs.0.00.
